subject: Web Development
title: Next.js: React Goes Full-Stack
description: A fast breakdown of Next.js: React Goes Full-Stack for builders.

hook.text: React was just a view library. Next.js turned it into a complete web framework.

buildup.text: Next.js added server-side rendering, file-based routing, and API endpoints out of the box.

discovery.text: Developers could build full applications without configuring Webpack or Express.

twist.text: Vercel, the company behind Next.js, profits from hosting it. The line between tool and vendor blurred.

climax.text: Next.js became the most popular React framework, powering sites from Nike to TikTok.

punchline.text: A framework company became a platform company.
